phases.title: Phase 00 — Name the target honestly
phases.goal: Define exactly what Maccie is, what it is not, and what counts as reaching a local native model.

phases.title: Phase 01 — Freeze the inherited source trace
phases.goal: Preserve the exact AXM foundation and conversation lineage Maccie is allowed to build on.

phases.title: Phase 02 — Create the Maccie research body
phases.goal: Establish a clean, modular local repository that can grow without contaminating the Workshop.

phases.title: Phase 03 — Freeze root governance as executable policy
phases.goal: Make principles affect computation while keeping amendment authority outside gradient learning.

phases.title: Phase 04 — Build the local runtime skeleton
phases.goal: Make Maccie exist as a stoppable, inspectable local process before it is intelligent.

phases.title: Phase 05 — Define the native API and Workshop adapter
phases.goal: Make Maccie connect through stable contracts without forcing its internal architecture to imitate an LLM.

phases.title: Phase 06 — Invent the Maccie state language
phases.goal: Give the machine a native representation richer than prose and more inspectable than hidden vectors.

phases.title: Phase 07 — Build the evidence and claim ledger
phases.goal: Ensure every conclusion can point back to what was observed, asserted, derived, or tested.

phases.title: Phase 08 — Implement the Principle Cell
phases.goal: Create the first real machine reasoning unit: observe, evaluate, decide, test, and repair.

phases.title: Phase 09 — Add consequence depth without scalar collapse
phases.goal: Evaluate actions across multiple futures while preserving why one path was chosen.

phases.title: Phase 10 — Build candidate generation and search
phases.goal: Move from judging one supplied action to constructing and comparing possible actions.

phases.title: Phase 11 — Define the simulator contract
phases.goal: Allow Maccie to reason in many worlds without hard-wiring one game's rules into the mind.

phases.title: Phase 12 — Create the first bounded curriculum worlds
phases.goal: Give the Principle Cell a reality it cannot bluff.

phases.title: Phase 13 — Turn Verifier and Seam-Finder into core organs
phases.goal: Make self-checking and missing-bridge detection part of every reasoning cycle.

phases.title: Phase 14 — Build memory as explicit machine continuity
phases.goal: Preserve experience without burying identity, authority, or truth inside opaque weights.

phases.title: Phase 15 — Establish the data and experience foundry
phases.goal: Create training material with stronger source integrity than ordinary opaque scraping.

phases.title: Phase 16 — Train the first learned Principle Organ
phases.goal: Produce the first genuinely native AXM weights without handing it final authority.

phases.title: Phase 17 — Train a learned world model
phases.goal: Let Maccie predict consequences from experience while retaining explicit verification.

phases.title: Phase 18 — Combine search, rules, and learned models
phases.goal: Create a hybrid reasoner where learned components propose and predict while explicit mechanisms verify and govern.

phases.title: Phase 19 — Implement real specialist architecture
phases.goal: Turn specialist masks into bounded modules with contracts, not role-play prompts.

phases.title: Phase 20 — Teach bounded tool use through the same gate
phases.goal: Let Maccie operate AXM tools as a machine participant without privileged access.

phases.title: Phase 21 — Learn machine-native sequences before prose
phases.goal: Train models to predict plans, state transitions, and tool structures rather than human-sounding conversation.

phases.title: Phase 22 — Choose the language encoding by experiment
phases.goal: Decide how human language enters Maccie without treating tokenization as an invisible inherited truth.

phases.title: Phase 23 — Train the first native language shell from scratch
phases.goal: Give Maccie a modest human communication layer without making prose the decision authority.

phases.title: Phase 24 — Add dialogue and collaboration continuity
phases.goal: Make Maccie useful across turns without turning chat history into unbounded hidden authority.

phases.title: Phase 25 — Give Maccie eyes through the shared vision loop
phases.goal: Add visual observation without granting hidden omniscience or bypassing the human-visible screen.

phases.title: Phase 26 — Build the AXM wisdom and integrity benchmark
phases.goal: Measure whether capability grows without principles becoming decorative.

phases.title: Phase 27 — Attack the system before trusting it
phases.goal: Pressure-test local security, consent, memory, tools, and learned behavior.

phases.title: Phase 28 — Build the reproducible training foundry
phases.goal: Turn experiments into repeatable engineering rather than one-off lucky runs.

phases.title: Phase 29 — Scale by capability rungs, not hype
phases.goal: Grow Maccie only when each scale demonstrates a specific new ability.

phases.title: Phase 30 — Package Maccie Local Collaborator v0.1
phases.goal: Deliver a genuinely native local machine participant that connects to the Workshop like Nova/Gemini while remaining its own architecture.

phases.title: Phase 31 — Continue beyond the first local model
phases.goal: Preserve an open-ended research path without pretending the forest has an endpoint.
